angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 730,485 km at 8.70 pc = 1.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 114.9497 +/- 0.5280 mas (same row, RUWE 5.62): 8.70 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 1.05 solar radii from Takeda et al. (2007), ApJS 168, 297, as listed by Willamo et al. (2022), Table 2, the values of the ZDI inversion (https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.06729). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
